name: Cutlass (4 Winds Fantasy Gaming)
body:
This broad curved sword is somewhat reminiscent of a short scimitar, but with a protective hand guard or basket hilt.

Benefit: Because it is light and easily wielded with little training, yet delivers nasty wounds, the cutlass is favored by rogues, bandits and pirates.
